hardware_gate.target_hardware: Linux x86-64 + 2x NVIDIA B200 GPUs + CUDA 13.0 for official Tufalabs/tufazip enwik9-v2.bin
hardware_gate.reason: Miniature fixed-point online-learning range codec (zero transferred online weights, bit-exact SHA-256 round-trip) and LZ77 baseline verified on CPU; official 2x B200 CUDA 13.0 tufazip runtime did not execute locally

negative_controls.detail: disabling decoder-side online weight relearning breaks bit-exact reconstruction (finding, not silent pass)
flipping one payload bit breaks SHA-256 round-trip verification
total size must include required offline prior/decoder bytes
full 1 GB enwik9 job is refused by bounded-prefix policy
official tufazip decoder requires Linux x86-64 + 2x NVIDIA B200 + CUDA 13.0
floating commit 'HEAD' is rejected; must pin exact tufazip SHA
author's enwik9 total, rank, and B200 timings are unverified related work, never pass gates
empty input yields None bpb and compression ratio (no division by zero)
